purchase.title: Purchase control workspace
purchase.subtitle: Supplier entitlement, batch items, PIN/BIN, funding, loading history and benefit reconciliation.
rules: Each purchase and purchaseItem is a root RecordType, not an embedded line.
Purchase confirmation posts Dr supplier prepaid/entitlement account and Cr bank account once.
Supplier PIN, BIN, login code and depot remain traceable throughout loading.
Price, quantity and discount on an item become immutable once its first loading exists.
Loaded, cleared and delivered quantities are separate counters; never infer one from another.

loading.title: Loading & clearance workspace
loading.subtitle: Allocate each truckload to customers or warehouse, confirm, clear and transfer ownership correctly.
rules: Customer quantity plus warehouse quantity must equal confirmed loading quantity; no negative quantities.
Support mixed destinations and multiple customer allocations, with independent destination statuses.
Total loading cannot exceed remaining purchase entitlement; clearances cannot exceed loaded quantity.
On confirmed loading: create customer_sales for customer quantity or inventory_movement for warehouse quantity.
Respect institution ownershipTransferPolicy: loading-transfer or delivery-transfer.
Never create purchaseItem records during loading; use existing immutable purchase-item references.

customer.title: Customer 360° workspace
customer.subtitle: Credit profile, negotiated prices, invoices, receipts, deliveries, returns and customer statement.
rules: Customers can be persons or companies; link to shared person record where applicable.
Enforce customer credit limits and payment terms on the server.
Customer-specific dated price lists, quantity breaks and authorized overrides resolve at sale entry.
Every sale line snapshots actual agreed price; later price list changes never rewrite history.
Invoice balances and statements derive from authoritative posted transactions.

sales.title: Sales & receivables workspace
sales.subtitle: Sales order, priced lines, stock/loading sources, tax, collections and delivery confirmation.
rules: One customer sale can contain multiple root customer_sale_item records.
Line source can be direct supplier loading or existing warehouse movement; prevent double selling.
Snapshot listed price, agreed price, discount, applicable tax and unit conversion on each line.
Do not book sales revenue or customer balance twice; statuses are server-controlled.
Support partial receipts, delivery proof, rejected quantities and returns.

warehouse.title: Inventory & stocktake workspace
warehouse.subtitle: Live stock by location/condition, movements, reserved quantities, cost layers and counted variances.
rules: Product inventory balances must never be manually edited: use confirmed/effective inventory movements.
InventoryKeepingMethod supports fixed, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and manual_stocktaken.
Valuation by configured FIFO or weighted average; keep historically correct cost layers.
A physical stocktake includes counted rows, variance approvals and posted adjustments.
Track good, damaged and other configured stock conditions separately; support returns.
Only confirmed/effective inventory_movement related actions update inventory_stock.

trip.title: Fleet & multi-stop trip workspace
trip.subtitle: Assign vehicle and driver, sequence multiple customers, add fuel/expenses and obtain proof of delivery.
rules: Trip has one assigned driver and vehicle, and may contain multiple destinations and customers.
trip_destination orders stops and links delivery quantities to sale / loading / product.
Trip-level fuel, maintenance and other expenses contribute to totalTripCost.
Allocate trip costs to customer sales when policy permits; trip net margin accounts for transport.
Proof of delivery can include accepted/rejected quantities, receiver, signature and photos.
Financial posting belongs to MetaForge services; do not treat local proof as authoritative.

staff.title: Staff, payroll & loans workspace
staff.subtitle: Employee profile, salary, monthly payroll, deductions, cooperative savings and staff loans.
rules: Staff_employment must link to person; employment can link to Cooperative member account.
Staff savings and staff loans reuse Cooperative RecordTypes, never duplicate them inside Cement.
Monthly salary uploads must have month/period, source file hash, row outcomes, reconciliation and history.
Deductions can route to savings contributions, loan repayments or other authorized ledger accounts.
Require payroll approval before payment/posting; posted payroll is immutable except reversal.
Isolate payroll visibility to authorized HR, Admin and Accountant roles.

finance.title: Accounting & reconciliation workspace
finance.subtitle: General ledger, journal traceability, purchase prepayments, receivables and bank reconciliation.
rules: Use shared Accounting RecordTypes: account_type, account, journal, journal_line, fiscal_year, account_balance.
Bank integration uses bank_account, bank_statement, bank_statement_line, bank_reconciliation.
Do not clone Accounting RecordTypes in Cement seeders.
Purchase posts Dr prepaid/entitlement GL and Cr bank GL once; subsequent clearing/ownership effects use policy.
Postings are balanced, atomic, idempotent; no frontend-generated ledger authority.
Year closing, account balances and reporting are handled by registered MetaForge services.

supplier.title: Supplier & depot workspace
supplier.subtitle: Supplier financial terms, unique PIN/BIN logic, depot configuration, product availability and incentive schemes.
rules: Supplier-to-product is many-to-many; map supplier product codes and valid depots.
Supplier controls the PIN/BIN/login-code flow on each purchase and loading.
Supplier purchase entitlement can remain open even after partial loading.
Optional supplier incentive schemes are controlled by enableIncentiveSchemes institution setting.
Record actual benefits even when no scheme is configured.

pricing.title: Products, units & pricing workspace
pricing.subtitle: Generic products, configurable bag/tonne conversion, dated customer/wholesale price books and overrides.
rules: Reusable ROOT RecordTypes: product_category, product, unit_of_measure, price_list, price_list_item.
Product identity includes brand/grade, inventory base unit, packaging, conversion metadata and active state.
50kg/bag conversion is not universal: derive from declared package size for each product.
Dated price entries can be retail, wholesale or customer-specific, with quantity thresholds and priority.
Authorized sales overrides are configurable; persist historical sale line snapshots.

incentives.title: Supplier incentive settlement workspace
incentives.subtitle: Scheme eligibility, direct benefits, rebates, actual receipts and receivable reconciliation.
rules: Incentive basis may be per purchase or actual loading; never assume one method.
enableIncentiveSchemes policy toggles eligibility schemes, not recording actual benefits.
Allow actual direct supplier benefits even without a scheme.
Track earned, received and outstanding amounts, with GL revenue/receivable mapping.
Receipt journals must be idempotent; support monthly supplier incentive reconciliation.

onboarding.title: Business onboarding & access workspace
onboarding.subtitle: Configure institution, operating branches, suppliers, customers, finance mappings and role-based access.
rules: Cement CI4 is a distinct frontend/backend; frontend calls only Cement CI4 endpoints.
Cement CI4 backend calls MetaForge auth, mutation and sync APIs; session authorization stays server side.
Portal → Module → RecordType; role belongs to exactly one Portal; send role-authorized routes/sidebar from backend.
Institution types and portals govern accessible modules; do not permit frontend role preview to override permissions.
Startup records include branches, suppliers, depots, products, units, customers, accounts, staff and roles.
System Admin importer uses validated rows and the same mutation API with idempotent retries.

reporting.title: Management reports & exports workspace
reporting.subtitle: 20 catalog reports, generated results, scheduled delivery, filters, export and audit lineage.
rules: Report definitions support generationMode frontend or server_stored.
server_stored generation persists report_result as a root record and supports export/email.
Expose date, period, supplier, product, depot, branch, customer, truck and staff filters where relevant.
Reports include purchases/entitlements, gross profit, stock valuation, aging, fuel, trip margin, payroll and dividends where authorized.
Users see only authorized report templates and scoped data; downloadable exports must enforce same permissions.
